title: Best App to Pay Credit Card Bill for Cashback in India (2026)
summary: Best app to pay credit card bill for cashback in India: super.money, CRED, CheQ and 7 more compared on rewards, platform fees and settlement speed, plus the 5% stacking trick.
body_markdown:
The best app to pay credit card bill for cashback in India right now is super.money for flat value (up to 5 percent on select UPI-linked payments), CRED for premium rewards on high credit scores, and CheQ if you juggle five or more cards (1 percent Chips on every payment). One warning before you chase cashback: several apps now charge a 1 to 1.18 percent platform fee, which can cost more than the reward earns.


This guide compares the top 10 credit card bill payment apps on rewards, fees, and settlement speed, shows the stacking trick that gets close to 5 percent value-back, and answers the CRED vs CheQ vs Google Pay questions honestly.


## Credit card bill payment apps: quick facts


Question Quick answer


Can you get cashback on bill payments? Yes, as coins, chips, vouchers, or scratch cards, rarely as flat cash


Highest advertised rate super.money, up to 5% on select UPI-linked payments


Biggest trap Platform fees of 1 to 1.18% that exceed the cashback


How payments route All third-party apps use Bharat Connect (BBPS) since July 2024, RBI mandate


Settlement time 12 to 48 hours typically, up to 3 business days for some banks


UPI limit for card bills Rs 5 lakh per transaction, Rs 6 lakh per day


Due today? Use your bank's own app, it reflects instantly and free


## How cashback on credit card bill payment actually works


Since July 2024, the RBI requires every third-party app to route credit card bill payments through Bharat Connect (BBPS). The apps make money through platform fees and engagement, and they share some of it back as rewards: CRED Coins, CheQ Chips, scratch cards, or direct cashback.


The math that matters: a 1 percent platform fee on a Rs 1,00,000 bill is Rs 1,000, more than most rewards on that payment are worth. Cashback chasing only wins when the fee is zero or the reward clearly beats it, so check the fee breakdown screen before every large payment.

Three of these deserve a closer look because the rewards differ in kind, not just size.


**super.money** is the current flat-cashback leader, advertising up to 5 percent on specific UPI-linked credit card payments with a deliberately simple interface. Rates are campaign-based, confirm the live rate on the payment screen.


**CRED** processes roughly Rs 15,000 crore of card bills a month, about a third of India's total, and pays in Coins redeemable for vouchers and mystery cashback. It gates entry around a 750 credit score, and how banks compute that number is covered in[how credit card approval works](https://gromo.in/blog/how-credit-card-approval-works/) .


**CheQ** pays a straightforward 1 percent in Chips on every payment and shines when you manage many cards in one dashboard, its Chips convert to Amazon, Zomato, and Flipkart vouchers.


## The stacking trick: close to 5% value-back


The best way to pay credit card bill for cashback online is to earn twice on the same money.


1. Spend on a card that rewards utility and bill categories, like Axis Ace or Airtel Axis.
2. Pay that card's bill through an app running a coupon or campaign, MobiKwik's monthly coupons or a CheQ offer.
3. The card earns on the spend, the app rewards the payment, and stacked together the value approaches 5 percent, the best way to pay credit card bill for cashback in India as long as no fee enters the chain.


Just never let a platform fee into the stack, one 1.18 percent fee wipes out both layers. And the stack only works if you pay in full: revolving a balance costs 3 to 3.75 percent per month in interest, which is the whole year's cashback gone in weeks, one of several[credit card hidden charges](https://gromo.in/blog/credit-card-hidden-charges/) that quietly beat rewards.


## Credit card bill payment cashback offers today


Credit card bill payment offers rotate weekly, so no article can list today's codes honestly. Where to check, in order: the Offers or Rewards tab inside super.money, CRED, and CheQ (current campaigns show before you pay), the MobiKwik coupons page for this month's bill payment codes, and your card issuer's app, banks like HDFC run their own bill payment bonuses on PayZapp.


A recurring pattern worth knowing: apps push their biggest bill payment cashback offers around festive sales, the same weeks banks push instant discounts, which is also when a cashback card earns most, as the[credit card for Flipkart sale](https://gromo.in/blog/credit-card-for-flipkart-sale/) guide shows.


## Before you pay: the 6-point checklist


The two that catch most people: pay 2 to 3 days early because BBPS settlement takes 12 to 48 hours and some banks take 3 business days, and a payment reflecting late means late fees plus interest that no cashback covers. And always pay the statement's full amount, minimum due keeps the account current but interest runs on the rest.

## FAQ: credit card bill payment apps and cashback


**1. Can we get cashback on credit card bill payment?**
Yes, but usually as reward currencies rather than flat cash: CRED Coins, CheQ Chips, scratch cards, or campaign cashback. super.money is the main app advertising flat cashback, up to 5 percent on select UPI-linked payments. Always net off any platform fee before counting the gain.


**2. Which app gives cashback on credit card bill payments?**
super.money, CRED, CheQ, MobiKwik, Amazon Pay, and PayZapp all reward bill payments in some form. PhonePe, Google Pay, and Paytm give occasional scratch cards rather than dependable rates.


**3. Is CRED better or CheQ?**
CRED wins on reward depth: brand vouchers, mystery cashback, and a polished experience, but it favours credit scores above 750. CheQ wins on predictability and multi-card management: a flat 1 percent in Chips on every payment with no score gate. Heavy single-card users lean CRED, five-card jugglers lean CheQ.


**4. Is CRED better than GPay?**
For rewards on bill payments, yes, CRED's Coins and offers beat Google Pay's occasional scratch cards. For speed and simplicity on a single card, Google Pay is free, fast, and has no score requirement. Both route through BBPS, so settlement time is similar.


**5. Where to pay a credit card bill with cashback?**
Start with the app matching your situation: super.money for flat cashback, CheQ for many cards, CRED for premium rewards, PayZapp for HDFC cards, and MobiKwik when its monthly coupon is live. Verify the fee screen shows zero before confirming.


**6. Which UPI app gives 5% cashback?**
No UPI app gives a guaranteed 5 percent on everything. super.money advertises up to 5 percent on select UPI-linked credit card payments, campaign terms apply. The dependable 5 percent in India comes from co-branded cards on their partner platforms, not from bill payment apps.


**7. What is the best app for paying credit card bills?**
For most people: CRED or CheQ for rewards plus reminders, super.money for cashback, your bank's own app when the bill is due today since it reflects instantly. There is no single best, match the app to your card count and timing.


**8. Which card gives 10% cashback?**
No card gives flat 10 percent on all spends. Ten percent exists as category offers, like Swiggy HDFC on Swiggy orders, and as instant discounts during festive sales on co-branded cards. Treat any flat 10 percent everywhere claim as marketing, the sustainable card rates are 1 to 5 percent.
